pages.text: Mathematical objects have to exist somewhere. The $(item)Platonic Compass$() takes you there: a bright realm of floating axiom stone where the five Platonic solids hang in the sky.

Plato held that perfect forms exist apart from the world. Here they do. $(item)Prime Number Ore$(), $(item)Transcendental Ore$() (π and e) and $(item)Fractal Ore$() grow here. Each solid is hollow, with $(thing)Euclid's Vault$() at its exact centre. There are only five such solids - Euclid proved it.
Points at the realm of ideal forms - and, used, takes you there (and back).$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.

$(thing)Dimension data: The Platonic Realm$()$(br2)$(thing)Nature$(): Gravity 1 g, 3 spatial dimensions, time x1, ordinary vacuum.$(br2)$(thing)Carry$(): $(item)Form of the Self$() - with it, only swords can dig.

$(thing)Natives$(): Axiom Sentinel, Fractal Wyrm.$(br2)$(thing)Landmarks$(): Platonic Solid, Menger Sponge, Sierpinski Tetrahedron, Mandelbulb, Cantor Dust, Hilbert Archive, Anomaly Vault Platonic Realm, Ore Prime Number.
